name: Tiny House with Chickens
description: Timber-frame tiny house with chickens in the yard, hand painted on cut-out native, wide pine board. Set the tone of any small space with the feel of farm and country life. A modest existence in a tiny house with happy chickens scratching in the dirt. I base my paintings on scenes from my life, or my dream life. Chickens are wonderful pets because they make comforting sounds as they search for food, happy noises when they find something yummy, and they're so funny when they run!I buy wide boards at a sawmill and cut out the shapes for my "canvas." Then I paint the front and sides, getting an extra chance for highlights and surprise shadows on the wood edges.Sometimes now I work with plywood because I can cut more intricate shapes.I like to distill sketches into silouettes, then cut these and re-interpret the cut-out form into a painting which needs no frame.
